q: Minimum 2 years relevant experience in Finance or Accounting.
Professional qualifications such as ACCA, CMA or CPA will be an advantage.
Experience working with ERP systems, preferably Oracle Financials
Sound Knowledge of accounting principles, financial controls and reporting procedures
Proficiency in MS Excel and other MS office applications.
Ability to prioritize tasks and Meet strict deadlines.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

d: As a General Manager, you will lead the overall operation of the hotel, aiming to maximize performance, profitability, and return on investment. Your primary focus will be on fostering a positive and productive work environment, ensuring exceptional guest service, and maintaining compliance with quality and operational standards. Additionally, you will be responsible for upholding and enhancing hotel standards and services to align with new industry innovations.
r: Develop and monitor financial and operational plans, aligning with the hotel and operating division objectives.
Create annual budgets and business plans, recommending capital improvements to enhance hotel assets and brand loyalty.
Oversee the delivery of superior guest services, ensuring prompt responses and effective resolution of complaints and requests.
Maintain product quality and service standards throughout the hotel.
Establish and maintain preventative maintenance programs to safeguard the physical assets of the hotel.
Develop strategic marketing opportunities and tactical sales plans to maximize revenue generation.
Oversee the execution of marketing plans and yield management efforts to maximize revenue, RevPAR, and occupancy levels.
Optimize banquet/outlet space usage and manage other revenue streams such as IT and Rental to maximize profits.
Collaborate with the Regional Corporate Office to ensure optimum productivity levels in all hotel areas.
Liaise with Government authorities to ensure alignment with legislation.
Drive Colleague Development initiatives and plans to enhance operating and service performance.
Develop and maintain relationships with key community contacts, ensuring a visible presence and effective handling of media/community inquiries.
Oversee the security function to maintain a safe and secure environment for guests, colleagues, and hotel assets.

Establish and maintain a proactive Human Resource function to ensure colleague motivation, training and development, pay and benefit administration, and compliance with policies, procedures, and local labor regulations.
Foster a positive work environment for all colleagues, providing mentorship through formal and informal meetings, discussions, and performance feedback.
Operate in a safe and environmentally friendly manner, prioritizing guests' and colleagues' health and safety, as well as environmental conservation.
Adhere to hotel environmental, health, and safety procedures and policies.

d: We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager / Area Manager to oversee Keemart's dark store operations across Kuwait. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in grocery retail operations, with proven experience managing multiple stores, leading operational teams, and driving performance across inventory management, order fulfilment, product availability, and customer experience. The role will be responsible for ensuring operational excellence across the dark store network, implementing standardized processes, optimizing operational efficiency, and supporting the company's expansion in the Kuwaiti market.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in grocery retail operations , supermarket operations, convenience store chains, or food retail, with at least 2 years in a managerial or multi-store supervisory role.
Proven experience managing multiple retail outlets, supermarkets, grocery stores, or dark stores, with a strong understanding of end-to-end store operations.
Strong knowledge of grocery inventory management, replenishment, stock rotation (FIFO/FEFO), expiry management, shrinkage control, and fresh food handling.
Solid understanding of retail operational KPIs, order fulfilment, workforce productivity, cost control, and operational performance management.
Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to manage multiple teams, develop store managers, and drive performance across different locations.

Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret operational data, identify performance gaps, and implement effective improvement plans. Experience with retail management systems, WMS, ERP, or BI tools is an advantage.
Excellent communication and cross-functional coordination skills.
Fluent in English; Arabic proficiency is an advantage.
Must be familiar with the Kuwaiti retail market and able to adapt to its operational requirements and business environment.
Candidates with experience in supermarket chains, hypermarkets, grocery delivery platforms, convenience store chains, or organized food retail businesses will be highly preferred.
r: Multi-Store Operations Management: Oversee the daily operations and overall performance of multiple dark stores, ensuring smooth operations, consistent service standards, and operational excellence across all locations.

Grocery Retail Operations: Manage end-to-end grocery operations, including receiving, storage, replenishment, picking, packing, dispatch, and inventory control, ensuring product availability and efficient order fulfilment.

Inventory & Shrinkage Management: Drive effective inventory management practices, including stock accuracy, expiry date monitoring, FIFO/FEFO compliance, waste reduction, shrinkage control, and stock replenishment.

Operational Performance: Monitor and improve key operational KPIs, including order fulfilment time, picking accuracy, order cancellation rate, stock availability, inventory accuracy, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop store managers and operational teams, ensuring clear accountability, effective workforce planning, and achievement of operational targets.

Process Optimization: Establish and implement standardized operational procedures across all dark stores, identifying opportunities to improve productivity, reduce operational costs, and enhance service quality.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with supply chain, procurement, merchandising, last-mile delivery, and commercial teams to ensure smooth coordination and resolve operational challenges.
Data Analysis & Reporting: Regularly review operational performance, analyze trends, prepare performance reports, and develop actionable improvement plans based on operational data.

Food Safety & Compliance: Ensure all dark stores comply with food safety, hygiene, storage, and operational standards, maintaining proper handling and storage conditions for fresh, chilled, frozen, and ambient products.
Network Expansion: Support the launch and operational setup of new dark stores, ensuring operational readiness, team deployment, process implementation, and smooth business ramp-up.

d: We are seeking a creative, skilled, and detail-oriented Photographer / Videographer to produce high-quality visual content for marketing, promotional campaigns, events, corporate activities, and digital platforms. The successful candidate will be responsible for planning and executing photo and video shoots, operating professional camera equipment, editing visual content, and delivering engaging media that aligns with the organization's branding and communication objectives.
Plan, coordinate, and execute photography and videography assignments for events, products, corporate activities, and marketing campaigns.
Capture high-quality photographs and videos using professional cameras, lighting, and audio equipment.
Create engaging visual content for websites, social media, advertisements, and promotional materials.
Perform photo editing, colour correction, video editing, and post-production using relevant software.
Develop creative concepts, storyboards, and shooting plans based on project requirements.
Coordinate with marketing teams, clients, and other departments to understand creative objectives.
Ensure proper setup, maintenance, and handling of photography and video equipment.
Manage media files, organize digital archives, and maintain content backups.
Deliver completed projects within agreed timelines and quality standards.
Stay updated with photography trends, video production techniques, and digital content formats.
Proven experience as a Photographer, Videographer, or in a similar creative media role.
Strong photography, videography, composition, lighting, and visual storytelling skills.
Proficiency in professional camera equipment and related accessories.
Experience with editing software such as Adobe Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve.
Ability to produce creative content for social media and digital marketing platforms.
Strong creative thinking, attention to detail, and time management skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Flexible to work evenings, weekends, and travel for events or production assignments when required.
A professional portfolio or showreel demonstrating photography and videography skills is required.
